verdict.rationale: Relay's support docs say users can check limits under Accounts → Limits and request an increase directly from that screen, which matches the self-service request the story describes. A separate support article on viewing account limits backs up that this screen exists. A community review mentions limits that may be raised, but it does not show that the request flow fails. Missing for 10: confirmation that card-level transaction limits (not just account limits) can be raised from this screen, details on review or approval turnaround, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the request flow.
